name: b3.5
note: b3.4 + pulling, and the bar calms the chasers (D062). Standing still (no step, no run, or during a probe), you pull the nearest seen ore or loot within your light radius out of the wall, through rock, one unit every pull.ticks; the cell turns to the most common rock round it, so no gap is left, and any move restarts the count. Each bug in the bar keeps one wild chaser away: chasers less the bar's bugs come for your ore, so with a full bar (barSlots) you're left in peace. Bar bugs roam barNear to barFar steps from you (field steps), a cell every barMoveTicks (half that while catching up), keeping their heading with a turn now and then and a pause now and then, instead of circling. b3.3 with the wild bugs living in the fog (D061). The world is cut into 32×32-tile blocks (x wraps); the 64 blocks nearest you each hold one wild bug, in a dark open cell of the block (not lit now, at least 4 steps from you, never within den tiles of a placed bug), sealed caves included, so they hint at hidden caves. A wild bug wanders inside its block; at most 3 of them, the nearest that can reach you within seek steps through open cells, come for your ore and nibble as before. A block whose bug is tamed or gone gets a new one refillTicks later. This replaces b3.3's spawning near you. b3.2 with the tamed side redesigned (D060). Every nibble by any wild bug counts toward one shared total; at tame, the bug that took the last bite goes into the bug bar (barSlots, drawn along the bottom) and the count restarts; with the bar full, nobody is tamed. Bar bugs circle you and light `light` tiles around themselves like your light, seen for good. The 1 s hold places the bar's first bug at the open cell nearest to 2 above your head: its den, lit for good, where no wild bug comes within den tiles (it mines in step 3). Wild bugs show everywhere and light their surroundings for a moment as they blink, without making anything seen. b3.2 was b3.1 + wild moon bugs (D056, D059). Fireflies with no physics: they appear in dark cave cells you could reach (never within den tiles of a tamed bug), drift one cell every moveTicks toward you through open cells (planks count as open), and next to you nibble one ore from the pack every nibbleTicks, never loot. One that has eaten tame ore is tamed on the spot, and turns warm. A probe ring scares the wild bugs it passes for scareTicks. b3.1 is b2.1 + the probe centred on the probed block, and no teleport home (D055). ↓ on a floor (not a plank, not at a ledge edge, where it still climbs over) probes around the block under you; ↑ into rock probes the ceiling around the block above you, replacing mining it (D043). You stand still while the rings spread, one every ringTicks, revealing everything they cross for good; a flick reaches light radius + flick rings, a hold grows on until radius + hold or until released. You build planks to reach a ceiling. Nothing teleports you home: a deep fall just lands, and stepping onto the home cell with something in the pack counts it in, which empties the pack and resets the light. The rest is b2.1: light from the pack through open cells (D051), the seen map (D052); and b1.7: flick and hold (D046), planks paid 1 rock (D038, D039), stops at a wall or a plank crossing (D040, D045), clinging and gravity (D035).
